description: This PHP source file defines a class 'JsonErrorRenderer' responsible for rendering error information as JSON in a Slim Framework application. It extends 'AbstractErrorRenderer' and provides an implementation for formatting exceptions into JSON strings, including detailed exception information when requested.

classes.name: JsonErrorRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders error information as JSON, optionally including detailed exception trace information.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the error rendering process by converting exception details into a JSON string, with optional detailed exception information.

methods.description: Formats an individual Throwable into an array containing its type, code, message, file, and line number.
